fluff.overview:
Inspired by the success of its Victor design, HildCo Interplanetary developed a larger assault 'Mech capable of spearheading attacks against urban centers and hardened fortifications. First fielded in 2575 as the PLG-1N during the Reunification War, the hundred-ton Pillager was the largest BattleMech ever constructed by HildCo. The original design proved devastating in its intended role, and by 2594 the chassis had been upgraded to the PLG-3Z standard incorporating cutting-edge Star League technology including twin Gauss rifles.

The Pillager's reputation as a fearsome assault platform endured across centuries. Though production was interrupted during the Succession Wars, HildCo's eventual reintroduction of the PLG-3Z in 3058 restored the design to prominence, and the Pillager has since become a cornerstone of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces while seeing service across most major militaries and numerous mercenary commands.
fluff.capabilities:
Built on one of the largest chassis ever designed, the Pillager presents an intimidating sight on any battlefield. The Vlar 300 XL engine provides a top speed of 54 kilometers per hour, modest for an assault 'Mech but acceptable given the design's emphasis on overwhelming firepower. Three HildCo Model 13 jump jets grant the Pillager a ninety-meter jump capability, a remarkable feature for a hundred-ton design that allows it to navigate urban terrain and exploit elevated firing positions that would be inaccessible to most assault 'Mechs.

The Pillager's primary armament consists of twin Poland Main Model A Gauss rifles, capable of engaging targets at extreme range with devastating kinetic energy. A Defiance B3L large laser provides effective intermediate-range support, while four Ceres Arms medium lasers deliver a punishing close-range barrage. Nineteen tons of StarSlab armor offer excellent protection, and fourteen double heat sinks ensure the 'Mech runs remarkably cool even when firing its full complement of weapons.

The primary weakness of the design lies in its extralight engine. While the weight savings enable the Pillager's impressive weapons array, the loss of either side torso will disable the 'Mech entirely, a vulnerability that later Capellan variants have sought to address through alternative engine configurations and stealth systems.
fluff.history:
The Pillager was conceived during the build-up to the Reunification War as the Star League Defense Force required heavy assault assets capable of breaching fortified positions and fighting in dense urban environments. HildCo Interplanetary, already respected for the Victor design, delivered the PLG-1N in 2575. Armed with twin Autocannon/20s and supported by an SRM-4 launcher and medium lasers, the original Pillager was a close-range wrecking ball that earned a fearsome reputation during the first two decades of the Reunification War. Records indicate that enemy forces during those conflicts tended to flee at the mere sight of approaching Pillagers.

By 2594, the design was upgraded to the PLG-3Z standard, replacing the autocannons with twin Gauss rifles and the standard engine with an extralight model. This transformation turned the Pillager from a short-range brawler into a long-range devastator while retaining its jump capability. The PLG-3Z served throughout the Star League era and into the early Succession Wars, where the loss of advanced technology production lines eventually halted manufacturing. Critically, the factory on St. Ives survived intact, but the specialized component lines for Gauss rifles and XL engines did not.

For centuries, the Pillager existed only as a dwindling number of irreplaceable relics. HildCo particularly chose not to restart production of the simpler PLG-1N, instead waiting until the recovery of advanced technology made the superior PLG-3Z viable again. When production resumed in 3058, the Pillager quickly demonstrated its enduring value. During the FedCom Civil War and the Capellan-St. Ives conflict, the 'Mech proved its awesome power as strongholds and defenses collapsed when Pillager-led units assaulted them.

Following the reintegration of the St. Ives Compact, HildCo reopened its St. Ives plant for full production. The Strategios, having revamped the CCAF's tactical doctrines, commissioned HildCo to develop new variants reflecting Capellan strategic priorities. This led to the PLG-4Z, produced under license by Hellespont on Sian due to its stealth armor requirements, and subsequent variants incorporating Arrow IV artillery systems, triple strength myomer, and eventually Clan-technology autocannons acquired through trade with Clan Sea Fox. The Jihad inflicted severe damage on HildCo's facilities, with the St. Ives plant suffering sixty-seven percent capital and personnel losses during the Word of Blake's final attacks on the world. Despite this devastation, HildCo's board of directors rebuilt with state assistance, determined to fortify the factories against future threats.

The Pillager today serves in most house militaries and numerous mercenary commands, though the Capellan Confederation retains the largest concentration of the design thanks to HildCo's continued presence on St. Ives. A limited production run from General Motors on Kathil has also placed PLG-3Z models in Federated Suns service, ensuring the Pillager's battlefield presence extends well beyond the Confederation's borders.
fluff.deployment: This variant is proof of HildCo's willingness to adapt the Pillager to evolving Capellan tactical doctrine. Introduced around 3068, this variant directly reflects the Strategios' emphasis on combined-arms fire support by replacing one Gauss rifle with an Arrow IV artillery system carrying three tons of ammunition. An ER PPC replaces the large laser, while three ER medium lasers provide close defense. A Guardian ECM Suite enhances the 'Mech's electronic warfare capability. The trade-off is a reduction to only ten double heat sinks, creating potential heat management challenges for MechWarriors who fire indiscriminately. Despite this limitation, this variant offers a versatile combination of direct fire and indirect artillery support that few assault 'Mechs can match.
